scheme_name: Coding for Kids Initiative – CBSE & MeitY
overview: The Coding for Kids Initiative – CBSE & MeitY is a government initiative aimed at introducing coding education to school students in collaboration with the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) and the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY). The initiative seeks to promote digital literacy and computational thinking among school-going children across India. It is part of MeitY's broader efforts to promote digital literacy and future-ready skills in the education sector.
objectives: Introduce coding and computational thinking to school students
Promote digital literacy in school education
Prepare students for future-ready skills in technology
Strengthen collaboration between CBSE and MeitY for digital education initiatives
eligibility: The initiative is targeted at school students affiliated with the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) across India. Specific eligibility criteria for participation are not detailed in the provided evidence.
benefits: The initiative aims to provide students with foundational coding skills, enhance digital literacy, and prepare them for future technology-driven careers through structured coding education in schools.
financial_support: No specific financial support details such as grants, subsidies, or funding amounts are mentioned in the provided evidence for this initiative.
application_process: The application or participation process for the Coding for Kids Initiative is not detailed in the provided evidence. The URL https://meity.gov.in/coding primarily contains cookie consent and translation prompts, with no substantive information on application procedures.
implementing_agency: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
